text:
GTP::new
Description
Creates a new GTP message for given version & request-type. Valid values
for version are 1 or 2 only.
- Request-type: A value less than 256.
- Returns a TCL object of type “GTP-Message”
See also
GTP::parse
Syntax
GTP
::
new
<
version
>
<
type
>
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
set
t2
[
GTP
::
new
2
10
]
log
local0.
"GTP version [GTP::header version -message $t2]"
log
local0.
"GTP type [GTP::header type -message $t2]"
}
